name: Lightning armor / one-arm war state
limitations: Lost left arm is not regenerated; strike is descriptive and intact-arm grappling is not silently restored. Cooperative Double Lariat requires B and is excluded from solo moves.

name: Lightning armor / intact-arm state
limitations: Demonstrated living armor with intact arms, not the Third Raikage or a healed later limb. Finite chakra, contact exposure and narrow range remain; no unsupported numerical armor levels.
